shots.narration_span: 我讨厌重复交代东西。
shots.staging_blocking: IP faces the same small set of requirement notes around the current work desk.
shots.framing_strategy: medium human-first; enough desk context to see repetition
shots.composition_strategy: IP centered; duplicate notes cluster near one side instead of becoming full-screen text.
shots.visual_state: Repeated requirements are a lived work problem, not a title card.

shots.narration_span: “这个项目不要 PPT 风。”“先说结论。”“这个角色别画成人类客服。”
shots.staging_blocking: Three concise note objects recur around the same working setup.
shots.composition_strategy: Each note appears as a physical/sticky-note-like recurring prop while IP remains in environment.
shots.visual_state: Three specific preferences become repeatable story props.

shots.narration_span: 这种话第一次说叫需求。说到第五次，我就开始怀疑，到底谁是谁的助理。
shots.staging_blocking: Duplicate copies accumulate; IP counts them while AI waits innocently.
shots.framing_strategy: medium reaction with visible repeated props
shots.composition_strategy: IP face and duplicate notes share frame.
shots.visual_state: Fifth repetition turns requirement into absurd role reversal.

shots.narration_span: 所以我对 AI 一直有个特别简单的要求：我说过。你记住。别再让我说第二遍。
shots.staging_blocking: IP gathers the recurring notes and deliberately hands them to AI.
shots.composition_strategy: Notes move from IP side to AI side.
shots.visual_state: Desire is expressed as transfer, not manifesto text.

shots.narration_span: 如果把 AI 想成一个助理，那它面前其实一直有张桌子。
shots.staging_blocking: Same room reveals a finite active desk in front of AI; notebook station absent.
shots.framing_strategy: wide-medium to establish stable room geometry
shots.composition_strategy: Desk footprint, AI seat, overflow edge all visible.
shots.visual_state: Desk becomes a recurring world object, not a diagram.

shots.narration_span: 我今天要处理的资料、刚刚聊过的话、改到第三版的要求，全得先摆到这张桌子上。
shots.staging_blocking: IP places today files, recent chat, and versioned requirement sheets onto active desk.
shots.framing_strategy: medium-wide, show object placement and desk capacity
shots.composition_strategy: Materials occupy defined zones on same desk.
shots.visual_state: Current working set becomes spatially concrete.
acceptance_criteria: desk still readable as one surface

shots.narration_span: “刚才那个价格是多少？”它知道。
shots.subject_priority: visible price note on active desk
shots.staging_blocking: AI points to the still-visible current price note without searching elsewhere.
shots.composition_strategy: Price note near prior eye-trace position.
shots.visual_state: Current context feels useful because relevant info is already present.

shots.narration_span: “第三份文档里我删了哪段？”它也知道。
shots.staging_blocking: AI retrieves correct current-task version from the same desk.
shots.composition_strategy: Version stack visible in relation to active work surface.
shots.visual_state: Second success reinforces the mistaken memory intuition.

shots.narration_span: 我看着那张桌子，只有一个念头：还能加。
shots.staging_blocking: IP looks along desk edge and gestures wider.
shots.framing_strategy: medium-close reaction with desk edge in frame
shots.composition_strategy: Eye-line travels from current materials toward empty edge.
shots.visual_state: Wrong conclusion becomes visible as a decision impulse.

shots.narration_span: 于是桌子越换越大。
shots.staging_blocking: Desk extends within the same room while anchors stay fixed.
shots.composition_strategy: Stable wall/window anchors prove this is the same room.
shots.visual_state: Expansion is a state change, not a new random desk.

shots.narration_span: 今天的文件放上去。昨天的讨论放上去。前天改过三版、我自己都快忘了为什么改的东西，也放上去。
shots.staging_blocking: Three time layers progressively occupy more of the expanded desk.
shots.framing_strategy: wide/medium montage anchored to same camera geography
shots.composition_strategy: Today → yesterday → older versions fill distinct desk regions.
shots.visual_state: Accumulation itself is the action.

shots.narration_span: 后来它那个工位已经不像办公桌了。像我把整个项目文件夹拍扁以后，硬铺了一层桌布。
shots.staging_blocking: Desk now spans most of room like a flattened project folder; IP/AI look small beside it.
shots.composition_strategy: Room anchors remain visible to prove expansion rather than location change.
shots.visual_state: The tablecloth joke lands through scale.

shots.narration_span: 但桌子再大，终究还是会满。
shots.staging_blocking: AI holds a new file above a completely occupied work surface.
shots.framing_strategy: wide-medium; fullness and blocked action visible
shots.composition_strategy: New file hangs over center where no space remains.
shots.visual_state: Finite capacity appears as an action problem.

shots.narration_span: 新的资料还在往里进。旧的东西就得开始挪。
shots.staging_blocking: AI shifts older stacks from active desk toward overflow edge as new material arrives.
shots.framing_strategy: medium-wide spatial relation between ZONE_A and B
shots.composition_strategy: Movement from active center toward side overflow is primary.
shots.visual_state: Context management is shown as tradeoff.
acceptance_criteria: overflow edge distinct from notebook station

shots.narration_span: 这几页暂时用不上，先收起来。
shots.staging_blocking: AI places a small page stack into overflow/archive edge.
shots.composition_strategy: Active desk remains in background so removal is contextual.
shots.visual_state: Removal means off active surface, not erased forever.

shots.narration_span: 前面的讨论太长，压成一张摘要。
shots.subject_priority: thick discussion becomes one summary sheet
shots.staging_blocking: AI replaces a thick stack with one concise summary page on active desk.
shots.composition_strategy: Before/after occupy same desk zone.
shots.visual_state: Compaction reduces footprint while preserving a usable representation.
acceptance_criteria: do not imply exact product algorithm

shots.narration_span: 几个重复要求，合成一条。
shots.staging_blocking: Three similar requirement notes become one consolidated note.
shots.composition_strategy: Use same recurring preference colors/shapes from S002.
shots.visual_state: Dedup callback connects story and mechanism.

shots.narration_span: 我一看就急了。“哎，这个别收啊，我前面说过的。”
shots.subject_priority: IP stops AI from moving note
shots.staging_blocking: IP reaches across active desk and grabs at a note being moved.
shots.framing_strategy: medium two-shot; hands and faces visible
shots.composition_strategy: Crossed hands at center show conflict.
shots.visual_state: Fear of forgetting becomes physical interference.

shots.narration_span: 它看着我：“你是说哪一个？”
shots.staging_blocking: AI pauses with several similar notes and looks back at IP.
shots.composition_strategy: Notes between characters create the question visually.
shots.visual_state: The ambiguity turns back onto the narrator.

shots.narration_span: ……我自己也想了两秒。
shots.staging_blocking: IP's raised hand freezes; eyes move across similar notes.
shots.framing_strategy: close reaction with note edges in foreground
shots.composition_strategy: No extra visual information; silence owns the beat.
shots.visual_state: The narrator also cannot identify the supposedly important item.

shots.narration_span: 问题是，那句话它确实看过。一个小时前甚至还摆在桌面正中间。只是新的东西越来越多，它被挪走了。
shots.staging_blocking: IP finally spots the old note now at side/overflow while new material occupies center.
shots.framing_strategy: wide-medium POV relation; show old vs current position
shots.composition_strategy: Spatial before/after implied by desk zones.
shots.visual_state: The issue is displacement from current working surface.

shots.narration_span: 我得出的结论非常科学：桌子还是不够大。
shots.staging_blocking: IP unfolds or points to an even larger desk-extension plan.
shots.composition_strategy: Absurd expansion plan enters from frame edge.
shots.visual_state: Character misdiagnosis is the joke and next action.
acceptance_criteria: clearly wrong but believable character logic

shots.narration_span: 于是我继续扩。一张不够，两张。两张不够，把会议桌也搬过来。
shots.staging_blocking: Additional desk and meeting table connect into one growing active surface.
shots.composition_strategy: Furniture expands along same room direction.
shots.visual_state: Expansion itself becomes escalating comedy.

shots.narration_span: 实在不行，整个办公室地板都算桌面。
shots.staging_blocking: IP kneels placing project material across floor as active surface.
shots.framing_strategy: very wide/high enough to read floor takeover
shots.composition_strategy: Room is almost consumed by working material.
shots.visual_state: Maximum absurd extension before hard contrast.

shots.narration_span: 只要地方够大，总有一天，我可以把自己这辈子跟 AI 说过的话全部摊开。看起来问题已经快被我解决了。
shots.staging_blocking: IP stands satisfied in a room almost fully consumed by active materials.
shots.framing_strategy: very wide; tiny character vs huge footprint
shots.composition_strategy: Density/scale at maximum; hold before reset.
shots.visual_state: Wrong confidence peaks visually.
acceptance_criteria: no new gag beyond established metaphor

shots.narration_span: 直到第二周，我开了一个新任务。桌面干干净净。
shots.staging_blocking: Hard contrast: same room anchors, active desk clean; prior clutter gone from active surface.
shots.framing_strategy: wide matching composition to peak-clutter shot
shots.composition_strategy: Use matching geometry so the reset is undeniable.
shots.visual_state: New task resets current work surface without changing world identity.

shots.narration_span: 我随口说了一句：“还是按我喜欢的方式来。”
shots.staging_blocking: IP casually gestures from clean desk to AI as if nothing needs explaining.
shots.composition_strategy: Large clean negative space emphasizes missing context.
shots.visual_state: Expectation is visible through casual behavior.

shots.narration_span: 它问：“你喜欢什么方式？”
shots.staging_blocking: AI looks at empty active surface then back to IP.
shots.composition_strategy: Empty surface remains between them.
shots.visual_state: The gap is caused by absence of persistent preference.

shots.narration_span: 我盯着那张空桌子。然后又看了看我上周辛辛苦苦扩建出来的超级工位。
shots.subject_priority: empty current desk vs remembered huge workspace
shots.staging_blocking: IP alternates gaze between present clean desk and spatial callback/remembered huge footprint.
shots.framing_strategy: wide matched comparison or controlled associative contrast
shots.composition_strategy: Keep same room geometry to compare states rather than locations.
shots.visual_state: Current capacity and past expansion are explicitly contrasted.

shots.narration_span: 它解决的是：现在能放多少。不是：以后还能找回什么。
shots.subject_priority: active desk vs absent persistent record
shots.staging_blocking: IP touches current desk, then looks to an empty side position where no persistent note system exists yet.
shots.framing_strategy: medium-wide; relation between active surface and empty side space
shots.composition_strategy: Two spatial roles prepared before notebook introduction.
shots.visual_state: The conceptual distinction is embodied before terminology.

shots.narration_span: 我没继续买桌子。在旁边放了一本笔记。
shots.staging_blocking: IP places a small notebook at ZONE_C instead of expanding active desk.
shots.framing_strategy: medium object-handling with both zones visible
shots.composition_strategy: Desk and notebook are spatially separate but adjacent.
shots.visual_state: A new persistence object appears without changing current desk role.

shots.narration_span: 也没什么都往里记。只挑那些我真的不想再说第五遍，而且过几周还会用到的东西。
shots.staging_blocking: IP sorts many transient papers but writes only a few durable preference notes into notebook.
shots.composition_strategy: Large transient pile vs small selected set.
shots.visual_state: Memory is selective, not exhaustive transcript storage.

shots.narration_span: 比如：“视频先讲故事，别一上来讲概念。”“不要 PPT 风。”“能直接说结论，就别先绕三页背景。”
shots.staging_blocking: Notebook shows three concise recurring preferences.
shots.composition_strategy: Use same recurring preference wording/colors from opening.
shots.visual_state: Specific durable memories connect to opening friction.

shots.narration_span: 后来又开了一个新任务。桌面还是新的。
shots.staging_blocking: Same room: active desk clean again, but notebook remains at side station.
shots.composition_strategy: Desk reset and notebook persistence coexist in same frame.
shots.visual_state: Visual proof that current surface can reset while memory object persists.

shots.narration_span: 我说：“还是按以前的方式来。”它翻了一下旁边那本笔记。
shots.staging_blocking: AI reaches to notebook station before starting task.
shots.framing_strategy: medium two-shot with hand path from notebook to active desk
shots.composition_strategy: Retrieval movement connects side station to current surface.
shots.visual_state: Retrieval is an action, not magical recall.

shots.narration_span: “哦，对。”“先讲故事，不要 PPT 风。”这次我没说第二遍。
shots.staging_blocking: AI places/references the relevant preference on current desk; IP simply nods.
shots.framing_strategy: medium two-shot; note and reaction both readable
shots.composition_strategy: Retrieved note lands on active surface between them.
shots.visual_state: Human payoff is absence of repetition.

shots.narration_span: 桌子，是现在干活用的。笔记，是以后要找回来的。
shots.subject_priority: desk and notebook in one functional scene
shots.staging_blocking: AI uses current materials on desk while notebook sits separately at side.
shots.composition_strategy: Both systems visible with distinct spatial roles.
shots.visual_state: Two-line distinction is shown through concurrent function, not labeled boxes.

shots.narration_span: 前者装的是这一刻正在用的东西。后者留下的是以后还值得重新拿回来的东西。
shots.staging_blocking: Current-task paper stays on desk; durable preference is returned to notebook after use.
shots.composition_strategy: Objects travel to appropriate zones.
shots.visual_state: Function difference becomes behavior.

shots.narration_span: AI 里的 Context 和长期 Memory，大概也可以先这么理解。Context 更像眼前这张有限的工作台。
shots.subject_priority: term reveal anchored to active desk
shots.staging_blocking: Term appears only in subtitle/voice while camera remains on already-understood work surface.
shots.composition_strategy: No new diagram; active desk is still doing current work.
shots.visual_state: Technical name attaches to established intuition.

shots.narration_span: 当前任务里的话、资料和状态，要先在这里，它这一刻才能直接用。桌面越来越挤的时候，系统可能会整理、压缩，或者把一部分内容移出去。
shots.staging_blocking: A concise reprise shows current materials used, then crowding, summary/repositioning.
shots.framing_strategy: medium montage; reuse established states rather than inventing new diagram
shots.composition_strategy: Earlier visual grammar returns in compressed form.
shots.visual_state: Mechanism explanation reuses story evidence.

shots.narration_span: 而长期 Memory，不是把你以前说过的每句话永久铺满整张桌子。它更像桌边留下的一本笔记。以后需要的时候，再把相关的东西拿回来。
shots.subject_priority: selective persisted note retrieved into current desk
shots.staging_blocking: Notebook remains compact; one relevant note is taken from it and placed onto active desk.
shots.composition_strategy: Side-to-center retrieval path is primary.
shots.visual_state: Memory is persistence+retrieval, not all history permanently present.

shots.narration_span: 所以现在我再看到“上下文更长”，已经不会自动翻译成：“它记性更好了。”
shots.staging_blocking: IP sees old expansion plan and pushes/folds it aside.
shots.composition_strategy: Old plan appears near frame edge; current reasonable desk stays central.
shots.visual_state: Old diagnosis is explicitly discarded.

shots.narration_span: 桌子大，当然很好。项目复杂的时候，多摆几份资料总比少摆强。
shots.subject_priority: large-but-reasonable desk useful for complex current work
shots.staging_blocking: AI and IP comfortably use a larger active surface for several current documents.
shots.composition_strategy: More current material fits without absurd clutter.
shots.visual_state: Counter-idea preserved: larger context still helps current work.

shots.narration_span: 但桌子再大，也还是桌子。真正让我不用再说第五遍的，不是桌子无限变大。而是有些东西离开桌面以后，下一次，它还知道去哪里把它找回来。
shots.staging_blocking: On another fresh task, AI retrieves the durable preference from notebook and places it on clean active desk before IP needs to repeat anything.
shots.framing_strategy: wide-medium to object/reaction progression; final frame simplified
shots.composition_strategy: Notebook-to-desk path leads eye to quiet IP reaction.
shots.visual_state: Final payoff resolves the original human problem through retrieval behavior.
